inlines.v: PERFU'ME, noun [Latin per and fumus, smoke, or fumo, to fumigate.] 1. A substance that emits a scent or odor which affects agreeably the organs of smelling, as musk, civet, spices or aromatics of any kind; or any composition of aromatic substances. 2. The scent, odor or volatile particles emitted from sweet smelling substances. No rich perfumes refresh the fruitful field. PERFU'ME, verb transitive To scent; to fill or impregnate with a grateful odor; as, to perfume an apartment; to perfume a garment. And Carmel's flower top perfumes the skies.
